summary: E0.6: dev+prod compose stacks. Новый сервис choros в docker-compose.yml (build:., depends_on postgres/keycloak/flowable healthy, port APP_PORT:-3000); multi-stage Dockerfile (web-builder→app-builder→runtime, 3 стадии — копирует dist/, web/dist/, migrations/, ops/, нет src/ нет .env*); docker-compose.prod.yml (prod override: KC command=start, required-форма ${VAR:?msg} для всех чувствительных переменных, prod-тома choros_pgdata_prod); .env.prod.example с REPLACE_* placeholders; ops/docker-entrypoint.sh (migrations перед node dist/index.js, fail-fast при невалидном DATABASE_URL); CI fitness: compose-prod-config.sh (FF-T61-1..12 включая live docker compose up --wait), flowable/static-checks.sh (FF-FL-11 baseline updated). 13/13 AC; 3 adversarial-пробы (a: prod up без .env.prod → exit 1; b: volume isolation dev vs prod; c: runtime image clean); vitest 768/768; live stack: все 4 сервиса healthy, 29 миграций applied, /health HTTP 200. Ноль choros_* DDL-миграций, ноль src/ изменений.

findings.issue: ADR comment implies KC/Flowable volumes use _prod suffix analogously — misleading since they have no named volumes (state is in Postgres). Documentation ambiguity only, no data isolation gap.
grep pattern for bare choros_pgdata: is slightly coarse — sufficient for current content, not blocking.
findings.resolution: Accepted as-is; sufficient for file content

run_details.fitness_static: FF-T61-1..12 all green (compose-prod-config.sh); FF-FL-4..11 all green (flowable/static-checks.sh, baseline f693923)
run_details.live_stack: docker compose up -d --wait (project t0061retest): all 4 services healthy; 29 migrations applied; /health HTTP 200 {status:ok}; KC start-mode active; prod volume isolation confirmed
run_details.image_cleanliness: docker run --rm: dist/, web/dist/, migrations/, ops/ present; no .env*, no src/ (multi-stage confirmed)

ci_green.integration_honesty_d056: CI 'stack' job present in .github/workflows/ci.yml: npm ci + web build + docker compose up -d --wait. Uses real docker daemon, real healthchecks, real --wait flag. AC-13 integration-honestly gated. Verified live in t0061retest project (all 4 services healthy exit 0).

deviations_from_adr: R-1 (nit, closed): ADR §3.3 comment about KC/Flowable _prod volumes — misleading but harmless; KC/Flowable state lives in Postgres (covered by choros_pgdata_prod). Comment clarified in prod overlay.
R-2 (nit, accepted): FF-T61-4 grep pattern for bare choros_pgdata: slightly coarse — sufficient for current file content, not blocking.

KC healthcheck: uses bash /dev/tcp probe against container-internal port 9000 (not host-mapped KEYCLOAK_MGMT_PORT). Original design used ${KEYCLOAK_MGMT_PORT} but BusyBox/KC container lacks port-var at probe time; hardcoded 9000 is correct (KC management always binds 9000 internally). Authorized in FF-FL-11 baseline update to f693923.
Flowable healthcheck: URL-embedded basic-auth wget (BusyBox compat) instead of -u flag — documented in ADR as BusyBox constraint fix.

promote_guide.what_this_gives: Закрывает E0.6: choros-app добавлен в единый compose-стек; prod overlay готов для E0.7. Теперь `docker compose up` поднимает весь Choros (postgres + keycloak + flowable + choros-app) одной командой. Prod-стек: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --wait` — гейтится .env.prod с реальными кредами. Ноль изменений src/, ноль новых migrations, ноль новых tenant-таблиц.
how_to_run_dev_stack: 2. npm run build (или npm ci && npm run build:web && npm run build) — собирает dist/ и web/dist/ для Dockerfile.
3. docker compose up (или docker compose up -d --wait для detached).
4. Все 4 сервиса (postgres, keycloak, flowable, choros) поднимутся с healthcheck.
how_to_run_prod_stack: 2. Заполнить все REPLACE_* значения реальными кредами в .env.prod (никогда не коммитить .env.prod).
3. Запустить prod-стек: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.prod up -d --wait
4. Все 4 сервиса поднимутся в prod-режиме: KC в 'start' (не start-dev), prod-тома choros_pgdata_prod, NODE_ENV=production.
5. /health → HTTP 200 {status:ok}; миграции применяются автоматически при старте.

KNOWN GAP (до E0.7): KC TLS/hostname не настроен (KC_HOSTNAME, KC_HTTP_ENABLED=false); KC запускается в start-режиме без внешнего TLS. Prod hostname и TLS — E0.7 (founder-gated provisioning). До E0.7 prod-стек пригоден для home-server за Tailscale, но не для открытого интернета.
how_to_verify: npm run ci: tsc --noEmit / eslint src / vitest run — 768/768, 0 failures.
docker compose up -d --wait && docker compose ps — все 4 сервиса healthy.
